pairs.evidence: app/features/tools/devcases/devcase-vocabulary.test.ts:202 The catalog walker that enforces the forbidden 'case' variant deletes the innermost brace groups instead of expanding them, so the text of every plural/select branch is erased before the rule runs: '{n, plural, one {# case} other {# cases}}' reduces to '{n, plural, one other }' (verified), which leaves 39 plural/select messages in the guarded namespaces outside the ban, and the walker prints no strings-checked count that would show the gap.

techniques.evidence: app/features/tools/devcases/devcase-vocabulary.test.ts:202 Placeholders and plural branches are deleted, not expanded into samples, so branch text never reaches the prose rule. The walker reports no coverage count. The sibling i18n test does render with real values (devcase-studio-i18n.test.ts:272), but this walker does not.

app/features/tools/devcases/devcase-vocabulary.test.ts:173 A one-concept-one-rendering termbase ruling is recorded in docs/features/README.md. Its forbidden variants are held by a checker, not by a writer prompt.

app/features/tools/devcases/devcase-vocabulary.test.ts:193 The termbase forbidden-variant rule (an L1 class) blocks in test:unit from day one. Its allowlist must stay empty, and a separate test fails on a stale exemption.
